summary: Applied the blocking review finding by specifying deterministic test control for default official source resolution without using SENTI_OFFICIAL_PRESETS_REPO.

items.title: Default-source tests lack a controllable target
items.rationale: The spec requires no-env default-source behavior and source failure behavior while avoiding network-dependent tests. A test-controllable default source descriptor is required to make those requirements verifiable.
items.evidence: spec.json R1 and R5 require unset-env default source behavior; T-1 test_strategy now specifies the resolver test-control path without using SENTI_OFFICIAL_PRESETS_REPO.
items.notes: The spec now requires an internal helper/options or test hook that can substitute the default source descriptor/root while production callers keep DEFAULT_OFFICIAL_PRESET_SOURCE and SENTI_OFFICIAL_PRESETS_REPO remains unset in default-source tests.
